name: US-6 / Bear Mountain Bridge Road: Peekskill
summary: US-6 / Bear Mountain Bridge Road: Peekskill (5.2 km / 3.2 mi measured track). Author: “A very good twisting biking road if you can catch it at a time when there is not so much traffic.” Posted 2010-11-12 by Android_Andy. BBR rating 4/5. Track data 2010 vintage.

comments_captured.author: MotoWhip
comments_captured.text: Try to get here early, this is a really great stretch of fast turns but traffic can be really heavy. If you arent out to tear up the asphalt, its a nice ride even with the traffic.
